name: outlook-pst
description: Read, search, export, and manage local Outlook PST/OST mail.

interface.longDescription: Read and search PST/OST archives, export messages with hash manifests, and manage Classic Outlook items through previewed, approved changes. Local Python execution is required; live Outlook access requires Windows.
defaultPrompt: Search my local PST archive for messages matching a sender and date range.
Export matching messages to an approved local folder with a hash manifest.
Preview changes to selected Classic Outlook messages before applying them.
